lab.task: Ae. albopictus recorded presence vs other-mosquito background · 1,601 locations, 1,292 with held-out assignments · three 150 km spatial-block folds with 20 km buffers, plus longitude-sector and temperature holdouts · fixed RF and MaxNet probes
lab.fits: about 600 fixed model fits across five cycles

findings.title: Physical context helps a simple model, not the forest
findings.result: 206 physical variables: MaxNet spatial AP +0.042, random forest −0.004
findings.use: Give the niche term the full physical context; with a forest the gain is already captured.

findings.title: Simple compression of AlphaEarth is enough
findings.result: AP: PCA-16 0.831 · raw 64-D 0.821 · learned sparse code 0.809 (learned − raw −0.012, interval −0.028 to +0.010)
findings.use: Use raw or PCA-compressed embeddings. Sparse dictionaries cut reconstruction error 70% against a random dictionary but do not rank habitat better.

findings.title: No general gain from newer self-supervised encoders
findings.result: Environment + VISReg AP 0.8367 vs environment alone 0.8363 across 27 recipes; expansion VISReg change −0.009
findings.use: Do not add encoder pretraining to the method without a transfer gain.

findings.title: Adaptive expert gates do not generalise
findings.result: Equal mixing AP 0.8226 · learned global weights 0.8178 · environment-varying gate 0.8178; the gate failed its pre-declared test in 3 of 3 holdout designs
findings.use: Independent replication of our weighting (I2) and HiCo (I6) results: learned gates fit the training geography. HiCo-Fuse 2 replaces them with a fixed niche model and a small penalised head.

findings.title: AlphaEarth carries transfer to a new continent
findings.result: Random forest, Americas held out: AP 0.625 → 0.718 with AlphaEarth added
findings.use: Keep AlphaEarth in the niche term; its value is largest exactly where transfer is hardest.

findings.title: Ranking transfers, thresholds do not
findings.result: All six Europe-held-out models miss every detected site of a 313-site Austrian survey at their training threshold, while keeping ranking signal
findings.use: Maps must be read as relative rankings; calibrated occurrence needs an explicit observation/detection branch (next step).

not_featured: Input-recovery scores of six unsupervised fusion methods: no habitat endpoint, and correlated views make recovery easy.
Reconstruction gates of sparse autoencoders on their own: reconstruction quality is not habitat prediction.
Masked-JEPA adapter: its training loss rose and its rank collapsed, so it is not a valid test of the method.
Unverified benchmark candidates from literature monitoring (RICapBench, VHR-Bench, PUMA): not admitted.
next: Separate ecological state from observation and detection (shared representation, report and survey heads)
Freeze a genuinely unused 2025 validation cohort before any further promotion
Add water, thermal and soil sources one at a time against transfer failures
